study.scope: Reanalysis of publicly deposited industrial-derived daily indicators; not raw SCADA reconstruction, diagnostic ground truth, or operational CIP control.
study.development: training label day < 450; validation origin >= 450 and label day < 550
study.rolling_fit_rule: Every training target is observed strictly before the test-block start. Fixed model specifications; no test tuning.
study.held_out_train_test: For each of A/B/C, fit other two trains using target day < 550; test held-out train at origins >= 550. No held-out train rows in fitted preprocessors or models.
study.pair_rule: Exact observed t+h label only; exclude pairs with CIP at t or between t and t+h inclusive. This is a conditional no-intervening-cleaning retrospective benchmark, not a policy forecast.
study.history_rule: Use only observed rows <= origin day after most recent known CIP; no interpolation, future imputation, or future-aware metadata.

methods.median3_7d: median of latest up to 3 observed rows in trailing 7 calendar days, no CIP crossing

study.candidate_gate: A model is only a promising candidate if pooled rolling MAE improves by >=5%, improvement is positive in >=3 of 4 blocks, and held-out-train pooled MAE improves by >=5%. This gate is a research screen, not operational acceptance.
study.unit: dimensionless published indicator units; multiply MAE by 100 only to express points on the deposited 0–1 score, not percent physical pressure or general accuracy
study.source_semantic_limit: Deposit dictionary says fixed-baseline deviations, while deposited scripts distinguish per-CIP dp_pct/ndp_pct from fixed-baseline DP_norm. Keep exact deposited labels; do not assign raw pressure or energy semantics. Upstream derivation cannot be audited without withheld raw data.

inventory.warning_raw_sample_count: Sum across train-day aggregations, not independent calendar observations; some daily counts exceed 144. Do not equate this to unique raw records.

provenance.source_semantic_discrepancy: Deposit dictionary says fixed-baseline deviations, while deposited scripts distinguish per-CIP dp_pct/ndp_pct from fixed-baseline DP_norm. Keep exact deposited labels; do not assign raw pressure or energy semantics. Upstream derivation cannot be audited without withheld raw data.

future_mutation_invariance.mutated: Future channel values, future raw-count metadata, future CIP events, all future-aware state/next-CIP metadata, and supplied CIP-age column
